title: Calor
description: Calor is a worldgen datapack for Minecraft versions 1.21 and newer. It raises both the sea level and snow line.
body:
**Calor** is a worldgen _datapack_ for Minecraft versions **1.21** and newer which raises the sea level.
 
> What are the differences between the versions?
- 1 ~ raises the sea level
- 2 ~ raises the snow line and removes some cold biomes.

> What do the last numbers of a version stand for?
- 1.175 -> 75 is the Y level of the sea.
  
**Please consider donating!** 
> What will your money be used for? A Desktop PC.
